conviction_note: The quarter is likely to beat the company's own Q3 budget (OP 407m in the Q2 deck) and land near the IFIS consensus, so the print turns on the forecast decision. This company has not revised its full-year plan at a Q3 print in any of the last four years; it revises in July and mid-November. The IFIS consensus (OP 1,400m, ordinary 1,300m) sits above the plan (1,340/1,240), and the identical setup last year (Q3 ordinary +62%, progress 92.8%, plan held) cost -12.7% the next day. A roughly 20% chance of an early revision (+8 to +12 on the Q2 precedent) keeps the lean modest: p_up 42 on a 6% scale gives -0.96, close to the findings' sum of -1.0.
bar: Q3 (Jun-Aug) operating profit against the company's own Q3 budget of 407m on sales of 9,270m, read off the revised-budget chart in the Q2 決算補足説明資料 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260716/140120260716594945.pdf; 235+578+407+120 = 1,340 FY plan). Street bar: IFIS FY consensus OP 1,400m / ordinary 1,300m / NP 560m as of 2026-10-14 (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=3547), against the company plan of 1,340/1,240/500 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715594688.pdf). The print_vs_bar figure is my estimate of Q3 sales against the 9,270m budget (about +3 to +4%); I estimate OP at about 470m against 407m, inside a 380-560m range.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-10-14: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (short_ratio 0.0, change 0.0; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 2.26 (kabutan, 2026-10-15), so margin longs moderately outweigh margin shorts and there is no squeeze fuel. No option skew exists. Run-up: +4.93% over 20 sessions and +0.26% over 5. priced_lean_pct is -0.42. The stock was +0.26% at 09:47 JST on 10-15 while the Nikkei was down 3.8%.

findings.finding: This company has not revised its full-year forecast at the Q3 print in any of the last four fiscal years. Its revisions came at the Q2 print and in mid-November (22/07/15 and 22/11/15; 23/07/14 and 23/11/15; 24/11/15; 25/11/19). Q4 FY26 also carries costs management has already flagged: the rebranding from 9/4, the 100-yen highball pricing from 9/10, and front-loaded PISOLA opening costs. The likely outcome is a held plan (OP 1,340m / ordinary 1,240m), which sits below the IFIS consensus of 1,400/1,300. The same setup last year (Q3 ordinary +62%, 9M progress 92.8% against a 5-year average of 83.5%, plan held) fell 323 yen (-12.7%) the next day, with kabutan citing '通期予想据え置きをマイナス視'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY25 (2025-10-15 16:30 release): strong quarter, plan held, -12.7% next session (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3547&b=n202510170125). Q2 FY26 (2026-07-15): FY OP raised 34%, +12.1% next session (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3547&b=n202607170104). Guidance is the line this stock trades on, in both directions.
findings.why_not_priced: Holders are positioned for upside: IFIS sits above the plan and has been flat for four weeks at 1,300 ordinary, the target is 2,300 against a 1,957 spot, margin longs run 2.26x shorts, and the stock is +9% since the post-revision close of 1,795. If the market expected a hold, the consensus would sit at the plan and the stock would not have held up into the print. The revision-date pattern sits only behind kabutan's premium revision table and the TDnet archive; no wire copy says this company does not revise at Q3.
findings.independence: The September 18 divestiture notice explicitly says the FY impact is 'minor', which removes one possible trigger for a revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260918538745.pdf). The October 7 monthly (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261007/140120261007547008.pdf) shows September traffic only +1.5% at existing stores after the 100-yen highball launch, which gives management a reason to keep the Q4 cushion. Both are company documents, separate from the revision history.

findings.finding: Q3 (Jun-Aug) is likely to beat the company's own Q3 budget of OP 407m / sales 9,270m. The direct-store all-store sales were 118.3/117.4/124.4% for 串カツ田中 and 138.3/139.4/138.0% for PISOLA (yoy). Against that sit decelerating 串カツ existing-store sales (98.8/100.1/105.6%, lapping the June 2025 media boost) and August opening costs. My estimate is Q3 OP of about 470m and a 9M OP progress rate of about 96%, against last year's 9M ordinary progress of 92.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY25: the quarter beat strongly and kabutan listed it as 大幅増益, yet the stock fell 12.7% because the plan was held. Q1 FY26 (2026-04-14): +1.2%. Quarter beats alone have not lifted this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the monthly figures are public, and the IFIS FY consensus at 1,400 OP already implies H2 above the company's 527m. The part not visible is the margin, because the monthlies give sales and not profit. That residual is the only reason this finding is non-zero.
findings.independence: The monthly reports (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261007/140120261007547008.pdf, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260907/140120260907532279.pdf) are company documents separate from the Q2 deck the budget comes from. The IFIS FY consensus above plan (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=3547) points the same way on the level.

outside_window.finding: The ハウスミール business (FY25 sales 1,303m, assets 240m) is to be carved out on 11/1 and sold to 鮮冷 on 11/30. The company calls the FY26 impact minor, and the price was not disclosed, so any gain lands at FY end.

The FY26 dividend is undecided ('－'). Last year the 15-yen dividend (+2) was set on 2025-11-19, not at Q3, and the likely date for both a dividend decision and the habitual November revision is mid-November.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with the mild negative priced lean (-0.42, margin overhang plus run-up) and the +4.9% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is an early full-year revision to or above IFIS (OP 1,400). I looked for one and found none pre-filed, and the company's four-year revision calendar says November. A Q3 margin beat could also carry the stock as 大幅増益 on kabutan's surprise list, which did not save it last year. Both keep p_up at 42 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public series means p_up toward 50): the guidance finding rests on what the release adds (the hold decision), not on the monthlies, so it stays. It is still a predicted reaction rather than a verified fact, so it was trimmed from -2.0 to -1.5 and p_up moved from 40 to 42.

Rule 2 (check the sign when negatives dominate): wrote the strongest positive (an early revision, plus the kabutan 大幅増益 listing) into baseline_tension and confirmed I searched for a pre-filed revision; no further change.
